title: observability: token-level cost & latency breakdowns, dashboard updates, and alert tuning for KV/cache metrics
author: Liam Chen
description: Motivation: Improve production observability for token-level cost and latency attribution across serving variants (hosted/dedicated/private) and surface actionable alerts tied to KV/cache behavior. This PR adds new Prometheus metrics, distributed tracing spans, dashboard panels, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy paging and better correlate cost regressions with request patterns. Changes: 1) Metrics: added redwood_inference_token_cost_total (labels: model, tenant, route, quantization_profile), redwood_inference_token_latency_bucketed (labels: model, tenant, route, stage), redwood_inference_kv_cache_hits_total and redwood_inference_kv_cache_misses_total. Metrics follow our cardinality guidelines and include optional tenant obfuscation flag. 2) Tracing: added explicit spans for kernel_selection, kv_lookup, batching_wait, and emit tags for cache.hit=true/false and quantized=true/false. Spans are paginated under trace.service=redwood-inference to keep traces focused. 3) Logging: structured log lines when per-request token cost exceeds threshold, emits request_id, model, and sample prompt hash (PII-safe). 4) Dashboards: new dashboard 'Token level cost & latency - per model' with panels for cost/time breakdowns, p50/p95 token latency histograms, KV hit-rate heatmap, and cost trend by quantization profile. 5) Alerts: tuned alerts to 10-minute windows to avoid noisy short spikes, added recovery conditions, and created a new SLO-based alert rule that ties increase in token_cost rate to a percent change vs 7-day baseline. 6) Feature flags: introduced feature_toggle.obs_token_details to gate cardinality-heavy metrics for accounts that opt-in. Migration and rollout: metrics default to off via feature flag for enterprise accounts; gradual rollout to internal staging, then canary in production for 48h, then full rollout. Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive; no breaking API changes. Checklist: - [x] Metrics schema and tests added - [x] Tracing spans integrated into runtime - [x] Dashboards added to grafana provisioning - [x] Alerts tuned and validated in staging - [x] Docs updated with examples and rollout plan - [x] Feature flagging in place and tested
